_how: To switch the dashboard to 2028: copy this file to data/elections/general-2028.json (any time; it leads once it is the next election within 150 days, and shows as 'next' before that). Then: (1) set the Senate 'held' counts from the 2026 results; (2) list Senate/governor races (or rely on discover); (3) add swing-state president races with Polymarket/Kalshi slugs and Wikipedia polling pages; every other state is modeled automatically from the 2024 baseline + national swing; (4) once a presidential national polling average is wired, set environment.national_override from it (until then the generic ballot stands in).
